note: What a server sends to put a unit on the field from the place its side sends them out of. It arrives on its own and also inside EnterSight.

fields.name: unit
fields.note: The name the unit answers to, so later messages can name it.

fields.name: node
fields.note: Which network node the unit belongs to. A client reads it apart from the name beside it rather than as that name's leading byte.

fields.name: barracks
fields.note: The place it came out of.

fields.name: wave
fields.note: Which run of units it belongs to.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: What sort of unit it is.

fields.name: damageBonus
fields.note: What is added to the damage it deals.

fields.name: healthBonus
fields.note: What is added to the health it holds.
